responsibility: This implementation module provides LONGREAL math operations by binding GNU Modula-2 procedures to GCC builtins where beneficial and to libm long-double routines elsewhere. It returns LONGREAL results for sqrt, exp, ln, sin, cos, tan, arctan, and entier, making it the long-precision math wrapper layer beneath gm2 source code that uses LONGREAL intrinsics.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the LMathLib0 pair: it realizes the LONGREAL routines by calling cbuiltin sqrtl/sinl/cosl and libm expl/logl/tanl/atanl/floorl. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/LMathLib0.def, it provides the executable bodies rather than just the exported interface.
